prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1346; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented after a low-speed head-on collision with right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. Mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported complaint, and the force involved accounts for the soft tissue findings documented on examination. Physical examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction, and a positive impingement sign. Imaging obtained at the initial visit clearly confirms the injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body region is known to this provider. Conservative management was initiated, including activity modification, a home stretching program, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. At the second visit the patient reported meaningful improvement in pain and function, with a fuller range of motion on re-examination. Care was tapered accordingly, and no further follow-up is currently scheduled unless symptoms recur. Billing records reflect one charge per encounter with no duplicated or repeated services.
